headline: Make security events part of your home
intro: Bring your Abode security system into Home Assistant to monitor alarm status, sensors, locks, cameras, and other connected devices. Use Abode events to build a useful response, such as turning on lights when an alarm sounds or notifying you when arming is blocked by an open door.
highlights: Arm or disarm the system and monitor sensor status
Use alarm, fault, and automation events to trigger responses
Connect Abode cameras, locks, lights, covers, and switches
